title: Checkers
short_description: Calm, classic 3D checkers (draughts) — turned wooden pieces on a warm board, with forced jumps, multi-jumps and kings.
description: A cozy, unhurried game of checkers rendered in clean 3D. Standard American draughts rules: men move diagonally forward, kings move any direction, captures are forced, and a jump that can continue must — chain your multi-jumps to sweep the board. Reach the far side to crown a king. Play a thoughtful AI across four skill levels, on a warm wooden board under soft light, with gentle piano. Left-click a piece, then a highlighted square.
controls_keyboard: Left-click a piece to select · click a highlighted square to move · Right-drag rotate camera · scroll zoom · Esc pause · F3 debug
